title: A position:fixed player shell has no meaningful DOM slot — an in-flow wrapper inserted there lands at the parent's content top and pushes page flow
trigger: A feature wraps/moves a player shell that turns out to be position:fixed (sticky/mini players — m.youtube #player-container-id sits directly on <body>). The inserted in-flow wrapper appears at the wrong place: covers fixed chrome at page top and shifts every flow sibling down by the wrapper height, while the page's reserved space for the player stays empty.
principle: For out-of-flow (fixed/absolute) elements, DOM position and visual position are decoupled — the DOM slot is just bookkeeping. A restructuring that inserts an in-flow box at that slot lands wherever the slot happens to be in the parent's flow, not where the element painted. When wrapping such a shell, the wrapper must replicate the shell's positioning (position:fixed + measured top/left/width + z-index) so it anchors at the original visual rect and leaves page flow untouched. Sticky shells are in-flow — they don't need this. Separately: when the video inside sizes itself off the stage WIDTH (padding-driven aspect-ratio), the stage height must follow the video's live rendered height — any px height captured before the width shrink letterboxes the video with dead space.

cases.context: m.youtube split view: #player-container-id is position:fixed on body, sibling of ytm-app (page content reserves the player slot via padding). In-flow wrapper inserted at that slot → y:0, covers the 48px masthead, pushes videoTitle 269→490; and stage height 221 letterboxed the 118px video (width-driven 16:9).
cases.bad:
wrapper.style.cssText = 'position:relative;width:100%;height:221px;...';
insertParent.appendChild(wrapper); // lands at body top, covers masthead

applyFor: Wrapping/reparenting any site element that may be position:fixed or absolute (sticky players, miniplayers, floating widgets)
Split view / player mode layout injection on mobile web video sites
Debugging 'page content shifted down / chrome covered after opening panel' bugs
